subject: Polaris dossier evaluation harness (TRACKER G5, gap #10): evaluateDossier and poc:dossier-evaluation
method: Each mutant replaced exactly one fragment (asserted to occur once) in the named file, ran both test files (npx vitest run <core test> <app test>, 30 tests), and restored the file; the worktree was clean afterwards. A mutant is killed when at least one test fails.
tests: packages/polaris-generation-core/src/dossier-evaluation.test.ts (25) and apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-generation/dossier-evaluation-main.test.ts (5); all fixtures synthetic, no external repository read, no provider call
history: At 2b5500ff a mutant deleting the head-text guard (`if (inHead()) return;`) survived: <title>, the only text-bearing head element, was already skipped as raw text. The guard was removed as redundant in the next commit, and the mutant replaced by title-counted, which removes title from the raw-text set.
